title: Before You Publish: Source, Claim, Destination
pin_title: Before You Publish: Source, Claim, Destination
body: Review the source behind the claim, the exact words in the caption, and the destination readers will open. A link should fulfill the promise of the post. This illustrated checklist is a fictional example of a ready-to-review content kit.
